testing_guidelines.rule: Every button, input, accordion, node tree item, tab, modal trigger, filter control, and completion checkbox MUST contain a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure UI is completely in Portuguese (pt-BR) as specified: Trilha, Fase, Módulo, Submódulo, Tópico, Rascunho, Publicado, Arquivado, Marcar como Concluído, Progresso, Reordenar, Dependências.
Provide seamless toggle between Admin CMS (Managing & Building learning trees) and Student Workspace (Catalog & Tree Navigation Reader).
Use clean modular cards, Lucide icons, Shadcn UI primitives (Dialog, Tabs, Accordion, Select, DropdownMenu, Badge, Progress, Switch, ScrollArea, Tooltip).
Implement rich tree visualization for tracks with depth levels, collapse/expand states, and visual status badges.
Implement interactive content block creation: Markdown, Code snippet with syntax display, Quiz with immediate feedback, Callout alert boxes.
Always maintain contrast accessibility standards on dark slate surfaces (#090D16 base background).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use Lucide or Radix icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
